nights.title: Giant Rooks
nights.name: Giant Rooks
nights.extract: Giant Rooks are a German indie rock band from Hamm, Germany founded in 2014. They are best known for their EP Wild Stare, their album How Have You Been? and their top-100 charting cover of "Tom's Diner" by Suzanne Vega.

en.who: giant rooks are a german indie rock band from hamm, germany, founded in 2014. they are best known for their ep wild stare, their album how have you been? and a top-100 charting cover of "tom's diner" by suzanne vega.
facts: they are best known for the ep wild stare.
their cover of "tom's diner" by suzanne vega charted in the top 100.
